$comment: Queue-level filing policy for agent/file-observer-findings.mjs and the precision gate in tests/telemetry-report.mjs (Matt Barge, 2026-10-15: our own checks file three times the work marketing requests; hold them to a precision standard). Thresholds live here, never in the observer's config (QC loop redesign 2026-09-24). Change a value only with a recorded decision.

spike.note: When one check's page-scoped groups in a single observer run reach minPages, they merge into one site-scoped ticket that lists every page. A real site-wide defect still files once; a run-wide measurement failure (2026-10-14/15: images-render on 57 pages from the observer's runner) files one ticket instead of one per page.

precision.note: A check that filed at least minFiled tickets in the trailing windowDays with precision below minPrecision is listed as a pause candidate in the telemetry report. Pausing (row status advisory) is a recorded decision via agent/record-decision.mjs, never automatic. Precision counts tickets that ended in a site change, a source change or a recorded decision; open tickets count against it, which is deliberate: a ticket nobody can act on is not precise.

paused.why: 28-day window to 2026-10-15: 18 filed, 0 ended in a change or decision, 18 false positive.
paused.revisit: Re-enable after the check distinguishes a sign-in or rate-limited response from a broken packet link, then watch two weeks of findings in the report.

paused.why: 28-day window to 2026-10-15: 12 filed, 0 ended in a change or decision, 5 false positive. Events belong to Hailey McSpadden; the website team cannot act on most findings.
paused.revisit: Re-enable as a report to the events owner rather than website tickets, if Hailey wants it.

pausedNote: A paused row is still measured by the observer and still appears in the telemetry report, so its precision can be re-read; the filer counts its findings and files nothing (like an advisory row). Adding or removing an entry is a recorded decision (agent/record-decision.mjs --spec-ref spec/filing-policy.json).
